confirmedFindings.title: Non-Atomic Call Pickup Connects Multiple Agents
confirmedFindings.body: Checking call.state === 'RINGING' and mutating call.assignedAgent without an atomic CAS operation or lock allows two agents executing pickup simultaneously to both receive success, resulting in conflicting SIP 200 OK responses.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use atomic Compare-And-Swap (CAS) to transition call state from RINGING to ANSWERED.
